title: Plücker determinant coordinates and normalized localization matrices
statement:
Let $N,r\in\mathbf N$ and put $k=r+1$. Let $\mathcal I$ be the $k$-element subsets of $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, with $\operatorname{columns}(I):\{0,\ldots,k-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$ their increasing enumerations. Define $B=\mathbf Z[p_I:I\in\mathcal I]$, graded by total degree with each $p_I$ of degree one [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. For an ordered tuple $t:\{0,\ldots,k-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$ put
$$p_t=\sum_{I\in\mathcal I}\det\bigl(\delta_{\operatorname{columns}(I)(a),t(b)}\bigr)_{a,b}\,p_I,$$
where the determinant is taken over $\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant]. Thus $p_t$ is the sorting sign times the increasing coordinate, or zero when indices repeat. For $I,K\in\mathcal I$, let $t_{I,a,j}$ be the tuple $\operatorname{columns}(I)$ with its $a$-th entry replaced by $j$, and define
$$C_{I,K}(a,b)=p_{t_{I,a,\operatorname{columns}(K)(b)}},\qquad F_{I,K}=p_I^r p_K-\det C_{I,K}.$$
Let $H$ be the ideal generated by all $F_{I,K}$ and let $A=B/H$, with quotient map $\pi$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Its degree-$d$ component is $A_d=\pi(B_d)$, with the induced quotient grading on these prescribed components. For every $I\in\mathcal I$, in the degree-zero homogeneous localization $A_{(\pi(p_I)),0}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], define
$$\operatorname{fraction}(I,t)=\frac{\pi(p_t)}{\pi(p_I)},\qquad M^{(I)}_{aj}=\operatorname{fraction}(I,t_{I,a,j}).$$
These are the determinant-coordinate ring, its fixed homogeneous components and grading, and its normalized localization matrices; no chart isomorphism or transition identity is asserted in this definition.
